REFERENCE_LINEAGE.surface_identity: A governed, human-in-the-loop bridge to external AI. The reviewer prepares an explicit packet from a declared source revision, carries it out of CEP by hand, imports the response, proves provenance equality, and only then decides. CEP never calls a provider and never publishes canonically — so the composition puts human authority over AI output at the centre: every exchange stage, every provenance check and every disposition is visible, labelled and inspectable.
